promptText:
Create one opaque 1254×1254 structural region guide for the original Daoist chibi game 五行奇谈. This is the single neutral geometry base shared by day and Spring appearances for r09_c11, not a new seasonal composition. Keep the fixed isometric camera, object scale and framing of Image 1. Its 4326-square extent maps to whole-city [40845,32653,45171,36979), with the future 4096 core inset 115 pixels.

Image 1 is the true mapped crop of the original day whole-city layout with the exact west neighbor band. Image 2 is that full-height native 230-pixel band from tone-refined selected-v2 r09_c10, for exact boundary geometry, material and color continuity. Image 3 is the user-confirmed PRIMARY rendering/material style: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi hand painting, clear contours, soft sculpted highlights, restrained stone detail; copy no UI.

Reconstruct the existing pale arched stone bridge continuing from the west: cream bridge deck, gray-white balustrades and square capped posts, curving arch below, and the existing descending steps and landing toward the lower right. Preserve the river around and under it, the tree trunks/canopies above and at the right edge, and clipped shrubs at the bottom. Keep every bridge entry, walkway width, railing footprint, shore, planting footprint, occlusion and cast-shadow relationship. Extend the precise west-band rail endpoints and paving joints naturally into the mapped structure. The vertical line at x230 in the 4326 guide (about x66.7 in Image 1) is a reference paste boundary, never a wall, ledge, stripe or extra post. The band must not be stretched; treat any unresolved mismatch as a review issue.

Keep neutral existing stone, green foliage and clear turquoise-blue water. Add no festival objects, new trees, extra piers, fences, medallions, buildings, lanterns, text, characters or obstacles. Do not narrow or reroute the bridge. Clean stone with crisp joints and rounded bevels, no dirt, noise, excessive cracks, blur or sharpening halos. Return one full-bleed scene without annotations or grid. This output remains a regional layout guide only; final pixels will come from sixteen separately generated native detail pieces, never enlargement of this guide.
